questions.question: What is a soliloquy?
options: A speech in which a character reveals thoughts to the audience
The opening scene of a play
questions.explanation: In a soliloquy, a character alone on stage reveals inner thoughts directly to the audience.

questions.question: What is dramatic irony?
options: When the audience knows something the characters do not
When a play has a sad ending
questions.explanation: Dramatic irony creates tension because the audience possesses knowledge the characters lack.

questions.question: What is mise-en-scene?
options: Everything visible in a frame — set, costumes, lighting and actors
questions.explanation: Mise-en-scene covers everything visible within the frame: set design, costumes, lighting and actor placement.

questions.question: What does analysing a film adaptation involve?
options: Examining what is kept, changed or added, and how visual elements alter meaning
Deciding which version is objectively best
questions.explanation: Adaptation analysis looks at the director's creative choices and how the change of medium affects meaning.

questions.question: What is cinematography?
options: The art of camera work and visual composition in film
questions.explanation: Cinematography is the art of camera work — angles, movement, framing and visual composition.
